subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text:
stimulus: what a beautiful sight it is said rabita in fact allah has created this universe very wonderfully said rukaiya Part B : Composition (40 Marks)
guide_solution: Change the sentences: (a) What a severe flood we have faced recently! (b) Very few floods in our country were as devastating as the recent one. (c) Didn't many people of the flood affected area become homeless? (d) Many people who were conscious came forward to help the flood victims. (e) The young generation didn't show any negative attitude in this regard. (f) They extended their helping hands so that they could mitigate the sufferings of the flood victims. (g) In fact, they had to come forward. (h) They collected subscription and bought relief goods for the flood affected people. (i) The trained workers didn't take part in the rescue mission more skillfully than they. (j) The people of the whole country praised them highly.
